name: date-resolve
description: Verify or resolve dates deterministically. Use this any time you need to state a day-of-week for a specific date, resolve a relative date expression ('next Monday', 'this Friday'), or verify a date + day-of-week pairing. LLMs are unreliable at day-of-week arithmetic — always call this skill instead of computing dates yourself.

inputs.date: string? (ISO date like '2026-05-19', or natural format like 'May 19, 2026')
inputs.relative: string? (relative expression like 'next Monday', 'this Friday', 'Monday of the week of May 18')
inputs.expected_day: string? (day-of-week to verify against the resolved date, e.g. 'Monday')

outputs.correct: boolean? (present only when expected_day is provided — true if day_of_week matches)
outputs.displayTimezone: string? (human-readable timezone label, e.g. 'EDT (UTC-04:00)', or null if timezone not configured)
